character.name: Andreas Veskren
character.background: Nobody (aspiring legend), former toll-house clerk with a sharp tongue and an emptier ledger.
traits: Ledger-Mind: You remember routes, prices, debts, and routines with cold precision; you can reconstruct a building's entrances and hazards from rumor alone.
Luck of the Overlooked: Once per long rest, you can reroll a failed attack roll, ability check, or saving throw; the world blinks when a nobody moves.
Silver Steps Ahead: Before a risky plan, you can describe three contingencies; if one becomes relevant, you gain advantage on the first check made to use it.
Hunger for a Name: When you perform a daring deed before witnesses, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier, lasting until your next long rest.
character.gear: Grave-iron dagger · Patchwork luckcoat · Hard oat cakes x3 · Bitter healing draught · Blank vowbook · Hempen rope · Tallow candles x2
character.story: Andreas Veskren spent years stamping other people's futures at a river toll-house while his own rotted. The haunting began when he saw his name in the ledger of the dead, written by mistake. He tore out the page and fled. With saved coins, a stolen dagger, and a vowbook blank as a grave, he walks toward the Ashen Courts where legends are bought with blood. He wants power, wealth, and a love that will not be priced. The emptiness follows him, whispering that a nobody who becomes remembered may be remembered as a warning.

inventory.name: Grave-iron dagger
inventory.lore: Forged from a coffin nail pulled from the drowned cemetery of Veth-Morren; it was carried by a debt-collector who died counting his own teeth.
inventory.description: A thin, blackened dagger with a ring for a finger strap.

inventory.name: Patchwork luckcoat
inventory.lore: Sewn from the sleeves of three executed gamblers; every stitch is a debt someone refused to pay.
inventory.description: A worn leather jerkin reinforced with cloth and hope.

inventory.name: Hard oat cakes
inventory.lore: Bought from a miller who stamps each cake with a broken wheel, the mark of travelers who never returned.

inventory.name: Bitter healing draught
inventory.lore: Distilled from grave-moss and stolen honey by a blind apothecary who charged Andreas twice because he looked desperate.
inventory.description: A dark, bitter tonic that smells of wet stone and old flowers.
inventory.effects: When consumed, restores hit points equal to 2d4+2.

inventory.name: Blank vowbook
inventory.lore: Its pages were scraped from the skin of a false idol; whatever is written in it smells faintly of smoke and ambition.
inventory.description: A small, black-bound book waiting for a legend it has not yet decided to respect.
inventory.effects: Once per day, if you write a creature's true name and a debt or promise in the vowbook, you gain advantage on the next Persuasion or Deception check against that creature within 24 hours.

inventory.name: Hempen rope
inventory.lore: Bought cheap from a ferryman who used it to bind a coffin that kept knocking from inside.
inventory.description: Fifty feet of rough, reliable rope.

inventory.name: Tallow candles
inventory.lore: Rendered from the fat of a beacon-beast; their flames burn green when someone nearby is lying about their name.
inventory.description: Two squat candles with uneven wicks.
